name: a-config-override-cannot-carry-a-keel-restore-past-the-rule
description: BL2/T318 retry, the same bypass in its second spelling. `git -c <name>=<value>` also consumes a separate token, so the pre-fix finder read `a=b` as the subcommand and allowed a `restore` of the observation queue outright - and `-c` is the shape a delegate reaches for most readily, since it is how one silences a hook or a hint. Note that the value CONTAINS an `=`: that is not what saves it, because `-c` itself is what advances past the token. Verified against the pre-fix code: it exited 0.
